Get Clarity so you can act with confidence
We unify Microsoft 365 Defender and Microsoft Sentinel in Clarity, turning raw signals into prioritised incidents and fast containment. No alert-chasing. No guesswork. Just decisive response and security that stays aligned to what your business needs.
Explore how Clarity delivers Microsoft-powered MDR & MXDR

Scalable Protection
Our managed security services meet your organisation at its current cyber security posture, offering tailored solutions whether you’re a large, complex, international enterprise or a small business beginning your security journey.
As your organisation changes, Quorum Cyber’s managed security services scale seamlessly to ensure comprehensive protection aligned with your specific needs and growth trajectory. We offer three managed detection and response services, plus a dedicated data security service:
Clarity Defend
Managed detection and response for 24/7 monitoring, detection, and response, 365 days a year, to defend your Microsoft Cloud environment from attack.
Learn more
Clarity Extend
Enhanced security coverage for your Microsoft Cloud environment and third-party technologies across your entire IT ecosystem.
Learn more
Clarity Protect
Advanced detection and response to proactively safeguard and improve your cyber security posture.
Learn more
Clarity Data
Managed data security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP), to safeguard your data from cybercriminals, insider threats and accidental leakage.
Learn more
